label: prop:co-lp-dual-binding
title: LP dual for $CO$: covalent active-set $2$ ($+$ dative $=$ triple)
html: Proposition (conditional on conj:q-integer-mass-formula). For CO the covalent-bond-selection LP selects an active set of cardinality 2 — two orthogonal orbital channels \sigma \perp \pi, each an independent covalent channel rather than one accumulating chain of shared pairs. The observed triple bond is completed by a third, dative channel (an oxygen lone pair donated to carbon), giving total bond order 3 and making CO isoelectronic with \mathrm{N_2}.
heading: Proposition
